models.name: empiricalA
models.latex: A = A_{max}(T)\,\frac{Q}{Q + K_q(T)}\cdot\frac{C_c - \Gamma^*(T)}{C_c + K_{co}(T)} - R_d(T),\quad C_c = C_i - A/g_m\ (C_c = C_i \text{ when } g_m \ge 99)

params.name: Amax_Topt
params.description: temperature optimum of Amax, in kelvin (°C + 273.15; a value below 200 is read as °C)

params.name: gm
params.description: mesophyll conductance (Cc = Ci − A/gm); 99 or more means none (Cc = Ci)

models.name: fvcbC4
models.latex: A = \min\{A_c,\ A_j\},\quad V_p = \min\!\left(\tfrac{C_m V_{pmax}}{C_m+K_p},\ V_{pr}\right),\quad C_m = C_i - A/g_m

params.name: Jmax_Topt
params.description: temperature optimum of Jmax, in kelvin (°C + 273.15; a value below 200 is read as °C); above 1000 K, Jmax follows plain Arrhenius

params.name: alpha_psII
params.description: fraction of PSII activity in bundle sheath

params.name: x_etr
params.description: fraction of linear ETR to mesophyll

constraints.label: Vpmax > Vpr
constraints.description: PEP kinetic curve must reach its regeneration cap

constraints.label: Vpr breakpoint in Ci range
constraints.description: Keep the Vpmax→Vpr transition inside the data (Vpmax/Vpr identifiability)

constraints.label: Ac/Aj regime at high Ci
constraints.description: High light → Ac binds; low light → Aj binds, at saturating Ci

constraints.label: Rd ≈ 0.02·Vcmax
constraints.description: Weak prior pulling day respiration toward 0.02·Vcmax where the data leave Rd undetermined

params.name: Kmax
params.description: maximum hydraulic conductance at full hydration
params.units: units of K (dimensionless when fitted from PLC)

params.name: P50
params.description: water potential at 50% loss of conductivity (MPa)

params.name: wtlp
params.description: relative water content at turgor loss point

params.name: D
params.description: fractal dimension of the pore-size distribution
